ConfidenceIndicator.title: ConfidenceIndicator
ConfidenceIndicator.description:
Per-segment confidence + the input that limited it (spec Tech Note 4).

``value`` is the min-rule combination of ``freshness``, ``coverage``,
and ``1 - model_uncertainty``. ``limiter`` names whichever of the
three drove the value lowest.

FreshnessReport.title: FreshnessReport
FreshnessReport.description:
Response shape for `/admin/freshness`.

A *list* (wrapped) — not a single object — so Phase 3 can register
multiple data sources (imagery providers, incident feeds) without a
breaking API change.

url.title: Url
url.description: Pre-signed MinIO URL with a short TTL. Clients fetch the bytes directly from MinIO rather than proxying through the API.

ImageryReference.title: ImageryReference
ImageryReference.description: A pre-signed pointer to one piece of source imagery.

name.title: Name
name.description: Stable algorithm identifier (e.g., ``"pagerank-diffusion"``). Empty when the row predates Phase 4 (sentinel branch).

version.title: Version
version.description: Algorithm semver (e.g., ``"0.1.0"``). Combined with ``name`` this reconstructs the persisted ``propagation_algorithm_version`` string.

PropagationAlgorithmInfo.title: PropagationAlgorithmInfo
PropagationAlgorithmInfo.description:
Composite-risk propagator identity + parameters.

Surfaced in :class:`SegmentDetail` so the UI can label the
composite-breakdown panel with the algorithm name + semver. Reads
from ``scoring_runs.propagation_algorithm_version`` (Phase 4
onwards a real ``"<name>-<semver>"`` string; pre-Phase-4 rows
carry the ``"none-phase-2"`` sentinel).

composite_risk.title: Composite Risk
composite_risk.description: Composite risk. Phase 4: ``local_contribution + propagation_uplift``. The upper bound depends on the active composite weights (recorded in ADR 0006's parameters).

local_contribution.title: Local Contribution
local_contribution.description: Weighted local aggregate of the four sub-scores at this (segment, t). Phase 4: the same quantity the propagator received as the per-node input vector.

propagation_uplift.title: Propagation Uplift
propagation_uplift.description: Network contribution to composite risk — the portion that would not exist without the propagator. Phase 4: read directly from ``segment_scores.propagation_uplift``.

propagation_algorithm.description: Identity of the propagator that produced ``propagation_uplift``. ``None`` for pre-Phase 4 rows where the persisted ``propagation_algorithm_version`` is the sentinel ``"none-phase-2"``.

imagery.title: Imagery
imagery.description: Source imagery references backing this segment's perception sub-score. Empty when no imagery is available.

SegmentDetail.title: SegmentDetail
SegmentDetail.description:
Per-segment detail payload returned by GET /segments/{id}.

Phase 3 (API 3.0, breaking): ``confidence`` is a
``ConfidenceIndicator`` object (not a scalar); ``imagery`` carries
pre-signed URLs for the source images that backed
``sub_scores.lane_marking_quality``.

Phase 4 (API 4.0, non-breaking add): ``propagation_uplift`` and
``local_contribution`` split ``composite_risk`` into its
explainable components; ``propagation_algorithm`` carries the
propagator identity + semver from the most recent scoring run.

is_stub.title: Is Stub
is_stub.description: True if the value is a stub (no real scorer for this sub-score in this phase). Consumers must check this — Phase 2 carries is_stub=false only for glare_exposure.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Scorer-specific provenance (e.g., sun_azimuth_deg / sun_elevation_deg for glare). Safe to add fields without breaking consumers.

SubScore.title: SubScore
SubScore.description:
One sub-score's per-segment, per-timestamp output as exposed at
the API boundary.

Mirrors `scoring.interface.SubScoreResult` but lives in `api/` so
the API can evolve its serialization independently if needed.

SubScores.title: SubScores
SubScores.description:
Four sub-scores carried in every composite-risk response.

Phase 1 stub values. Phase 2 fills `glare_exposure`; Phase 3 fills
`lane_marking_quality` and `historical_correlation`; Phase 4 fills the
weighted composite. `junction_complexity` is derived from OSM topology
in Phase 3+.
